notes.title: 🔪 Brutal New Executions + Easy Mode Added!
notes.content:
We've just dropped a major update featuring a brand-new Execution Mechanic — allowing you to finish enemies in style with devastating close-range takedowns. Stagger your foes, move in, and unleash a cinematic, bone-crushing finisher.

What’s New:

⚡ Execution Finishers – When enemies are weakened, get close and trigger a brutal animation-based kill. It's fast, bloody, and satisfying.

Aand it gives you health,so game is made easier for those who still find game difficult😁😎

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278732/7ae4049b083907e151c66de197e20d4c693b9a7d.gif

💀 Stagger Thresholds – Enemies now enter a stagger state when damaged heavily, giving you a window to execute.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278732/f4070092a086ca574b2b12b33c6c64bc9db81b2a.gif

🎥 Cinematic Touches – We've added camera shake, time-slow effects, and dynamic angles to make every finisher feel impactful.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278732/f1134fef25c769145a8bb196712e929d4d2a61bd.gif

🩸 New Blood FX & SFX – More gore, more grit. You asked for it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278732/df2e1b11a64b224470178f58287cb80e45f79314.gif

This is just the start — more executions, enemy reactions, and polish are coming soon. Feedback helps us improve, so let us know what you think!

Stay sharp — and get ready to tear it up.

🎮 Easy Mode Added
We want everyone to enjoy the mayhem — at their own pace.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278732/f4eb027e689828814fe73d9c9f96cc42fc82d445.gif

Introducing Easy Mode:

🩹 +50% Health

🎯 Built-in Aim Assist

💸 -50% Score Penalty

Perfect for new players or anyone who just wants to rip through enemies and enjoy the chaos without the pressure. High scores will still require skill and survival in the standard mode.

Fixed BUGS:
-Unlocked Helmets unlocking again.

— GogaGames.

notes.title: 🚨 Helmet Update: Unleash New Powers! 🚨
notes.content:
Our latest update introduces Helmets with unique buffs and abilities to enhance your playstyle and give you the edge in every battle! ⚡

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278732/a4c5b9f633a1ddbbd78cc02982bafccc10c485bb.gif

AND MORE

Equip, upgrade, and dominate!
Dive into the update now and find the perfect helmet to match your style. Get ready to feel the power in every helmet! 💥

This Update also brings UI and Performance improvements!
Enjoy!

notes.title: Difficulty HOTFIX #2
notes.content:
Here's list of changes I made (thanks to feedback) to make game easier:

-melee hit staggers enemies
-ranged enemies get staggered for 2sec after melee hit
-melee hit pushes back enemies further
-Enemies hit slower
-Silvertime charges faster
-Weapon pickup is much easier!
-Small UI refinements(more coming soon)

I hope this helps! :)

notes.title: Difficulty HOTFIX #1
notes.content:
Most players found game too difficult,some even returned it because of this reason,I wanted game to be difficult but not to the degree where it hinders the experience and makes it not fun,
thru your feedback I now have idea on where game should be when it comes to level of difficulty.

I want to state clearly that this patch is only tiny part of the bigger balancing improvement game will get,
it's basically putting bandage on issues but hopefully will help and make the game more enjoyable to play ːsteamthumbsupː

Here's list of changes I made to make game easier:

-Buffed Damage on all ranged weapons! (but reduced rage mode damage multiplier from 3x to 2x but damage now is basically same as before)
-Buffed Kick and Fists damage!
-Fixed bug where ranged enemies shoot instantly on sight now they give you second to notice them and shoot first!
-Enemies move slower
-Silvertime charges faster
-reduced A rank requirement score on all levels!!!
-Small UI changes to make it more practical(more coming soon)

I hope this helps! :)
